dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It can be stressful to stand in the glare of a friend's brilliance.

dialogues.speaker: Paivio
dialogues.text: Heh, you're so right! It is stressful being his friend. But he's also one of the reasons I keep trying to become better.

dialogues.speaker: Paivio
dialogues.text: We're about the same age, but here I am, still not a Lightkeeper. It's time for me to really pull my socks up.
